about: Step content that is neither data nor route, anchored on a quest's goal: a step's tip (tip), a level gate before the goal (level), the goal's step shown only from a level (when: "level>=N"), a take on the way (early: { after: { quest, goal }, title, when?, tip? }, an along step right after the step of `after` listing the accept and its objectives until the quest's own step), or a slow, zone-wide collection worked over the stay (background: { title, tip?, mobs, mention?, finish: { title, tip?, map, x, y } }, on an objective: an `along until … background` step from the accept to the hand-in, a finish step before the hand-in, the mention in the steps between that pass the mobs). at: { quest, goal: accept | turnin | complete | objective, objective? }. forge-writer applies each record to the guides it writes, every build; forge data check-corrections checks this file. A record with faction (Alliance or Horde) holds for that side's routes only. Each record has a note, its source ({ kind, ref }) and its issue or pr.

background.title: Plainstrider Beaks as you go
background.tip: Plainstriders roam the plains all over the Barrens, and about one in four drops a beak: kill the ones you pass on the way.
background.mention: Plainstriders here count toward the beaks.

finish.title: Finish the Plainstrider Beaks
finish.tip: Still short of seven? Plainstriders are thickest on the plains north of the Crossroads, along the road north.

fixes.note: Plainstrider Menace: a slow, zone-wide collection, worked over the stay instead of in a step of its own (Fitz on #1135). Players' recordings: 266 beaks ticked from 906 kills of Greater, Fleeting and Ornery Plainstriders while the quest was open (26%, 26% and 18% a kill), a median 21 kills for the seven, up to 49; 16% of those kills already came in other steps; a median 31 s between plainstrider kills while on it, 176 s at p90. The plainstriders spawn in four clusters across the Barrens. The finish point is the best-sampled plainstrider ground near the Crossroads by kills a minute while on the quest (1.9 a minute, 45 kills in 23 minutes, 22 spawn points within 250 yd).

source.ref: players' in-game recordings since launch: 39 runs of 844 (38 finished), the kill and progress lines of Plainstrider Beak

background.title: Raptor Heads as you go
background.tip: Sunscale raptors roam the plains north and east of the Crossroads, and about three in four drop a head: kill the ones you pass on the way. Careful: Sunscale Screechers call nearby allies within 30 yd once below 30% health.
background.mention: Sunscale raptors here count toward the heads.

finish.title: Finish the Raptor Heads
finish.tip: Still short of twelve? The Sunscale Screechers are thickest on the plains around Echeyakee's lair, north of the Razormane camp.

fixes.note: Raptor Thieves: the heads drop often (about three Sunscale raptors in four), but the raptors are sparse and contested where the route goes: players' recordings show a median 77 s between raptor kills while on the quest, 447 s at p90, and a median 76 minutes from the accept to the twelfth head (up to 697), so it is worked over the stay instead of in a step of its own (Fitz on #1135). Per kill: Screecher 314 heads from 425 kills, Lashtail 73 from 99, Scytheclaw 29 from 82 (level 16-18, in the south). The finish point is the best raptor ground by kills a minute while on the quest (1.0 to 1.3 a minute around 55-57,13-17), which the route already crosses at Samophlange and Echeyakee.

source.ref: players' in-game recordings since launch: 38 runs of 869 (35 finished), the kill, position and progress lines of Raptor Head
